known_identifier_anchors.purpose: Known intracortical speech-neuroprosthesis publication used to test exact identifier continuity. Anchor retrieval never counts as new discovery.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:("brain-computer interface" OR "brain computer interface" OR "brain-machine interface" OR "brain machine interface")
TITLE_ABS:((neural OR brain OR cortical) AND (decoding OR decoder) AND ("machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR transformer OR "foundation model" OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: AI-enabled neural-decoding stratum that does not require explicit BCI terminology.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:((intracortical OR electrocorticography OR ECoG OR sEEG OR "stereo-EEG") AND (decoding OR interface OR prosthesis OR neuroprosthesis) AND ("machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR transformer OR algorithm OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: Invasive neural-interface stratum for papers described by modality rather than BCI labels.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:(("deep brain stimulation" OR neuromodulation OR neurostimulation OR stimulation) AND (adaptive OR "closed-loop" OR "closed loop") AND (algorithm OR classifier OR prediction OR "machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: Adaptive and closed-loop neuromodulation stratum, including algorithmic control papers not labelled NeuroAI.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:((EEG OR electroencephalography) AND ("foundation model" OR transformer OR "self-supervised" OR "self supervised" OR "representation learning"))
query_streams.purpose: EEG representation/foundation-model stratum spanning direct models and enabling model infrastructure.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:((brain OR neural OR cortical) AND (speech OR language OR communication) AND (decoder OR decoding OR prosthesis OR neuroprosthesis) AND (algorithm OR "machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: Communication-neuroprosthesis and neural speech/language decoding stratum.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:((retinal OR retina OR visual OR "visual cortex") AND (prosthesis OR neuroprosthesis OR implant) AND (algorithm OR "image processing" OR "machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: Visual and retinal neuroprosthesis stratum with explicit computational-role terms; inclusion still requires human review of the actual AI role.

query_streams.query_term: TITLE_ABS:((EEG OR electroencephalography OR neural OR "brain signal") AND (attention OR emotion OR fatigue OR "cognitive state" OR "mental state") AND (classification OR prediction OR inference OR "machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: Grey-area discovery stratum for neural-derived inference of attention, emotion, fatigue, cognitive state or mental state. A match is a review candidate only.

coverage_contract.mechanical_completion_semantics: Mechanical completion means only that one exact configured Europe PMC query traversal is cursor-valid and reconciles its materialized unique-result denominator against the reported hitCount for that traversal. It does not establish exhaustive NeuroAI publication recall, relevance, evidence quality, peer-review status, or scientific truth.

review_questions: Does the publication materially concern a NeuroAI-relevant system, model, dataset, neural interface, adaptive neurotechnology, or declared grey-area capability?
Is the publication identity resolved without fuzzy title merging?
Is the evidence state correctly distinguished among peer-reviewed article, preprint, correction/retraction, review, and other record type?
What exact system/model/dataset relationship, if any, is supported by the publication?
What inference is prohibited by this publication alone?

boundary: This programme defines a bounded Europe PMC publication-discovery strategy. Search hits are discovery candidates, not canonical evidence admission. Publication existence does not establish system identity, clinical effectiveness, safety, regulatory authorization, deployment, ethical acceptability, model validity, system conformance, or global NeuroAI publication completeness.
